data.name: DevSecAudit
data.videoCaption: Scanning a live domain, then working through the findings and re-testing them (in French).
content: A website security audit platform that scans a domain for common misconfigurations and returns a plain-English report with a risk score and concrete fix recommendations.

It runs around twenty independent checks — security headers, CORS, TLS, DNS and email records, exposed files, open ports, admin panels, technology fingerprinting, and lookalike domains — with passive checks by default and intrusive ones kept behind an explicit flag.

The project brings my security background and my platform work together: a Typer CLI and a FastAPI service share the same engine, long scans run as Celery jobs, and results are served through a Next.js dashboard.

data.name: BMCE OPV Platform
data.videoCaption: Walkthrough of the web portal and the mobile OPV subscription flow.
content: A web and mobile platform for BMCE OPV workflows, designed to support both internal administration and client-side request journeys.
The screenshots show the login experience, OPV administration, dashboard visibility, and the mobile flow for browsing and submitting requests.
Built with a product-first mindset, the project puts authentication, role-based access, and operational reliability at the center of the experience.

data.name: DriveLux — Car Rental
data.videoCaption: The public showcase, then the admin side: fleet, rentals and maintenance deadlines.
content: A premium car rental platform for the Moroccan market: a dark, bilingual showcase where clients browse the fleet and book instantly over WhatsApp, with no online payment to handle.

Behind it runs a full back office covering the whole rental lifecycle — fleet and client records, bookings, maintenance and regulatory deadlines such as insurance, vignette and technical inspection, scheduling, financial reporting, and per-section account permissions.
It is built to run at close to zero hosting cost: a Hono API and the React front end are served from the same origin on Vercel, backed by Supabase Postgres, with a daily cron handling renewals.

data.name: Spotify Playlist Downloader
data.videoCaption: Importing an exported list and fetching the matching audio, run locally on public-domain tracks.
content: An educational Flask application that takes a Spotify playlist exported as TXT or CSV and fetches the matching tracks from YouTube as MP3 or MP4.
Working from an exported file keeps the main flow free of API keys, and downloads are zipped and streamed straight to the browser rather than kept on the server.
I built it to get hands-on with API integration, media processing with yt-dlp, and background job handling; it is intended for local and personal use only.

data.name: Todo Planner
data.videoCaption: Adding tasks and subtasks, then moving through inbox, today and upcoming views.
content: A full-stack planning application designed to make personal organization feel fast, clear, and low-friction.
The product combines task tracking, scheduling, categorization, and reminders in a workflow that stays usable across desktop and mobile devices.
It reflects my interest in building complete products where interface quality, backend logic, and security-aware implementation all matter.
